title: Blocks & Iterators
intro: Blocks and iterators are uniquely Ruby and come up in virtually every Ruby fresher interview. This module covers block syntax (do...end for multi-line, curly braces for one-liners), how yield calls the block from inside a method, block_given? to check if a block was passed, and the core Enumerable methods every Ruby developer must know: each (iterate, returns original array), map/collect (transform, returns new array), select/filter (keep matching elements), reject (remove matching elements), find/detect (first match), reduce/inject (accumulate), any?, all?, none?, count, sort, sort_by, each_with_index, and each_with_object. Also covers the symbol-to-proc shorthand &:method_name and method chaining. The most common interview mistake: confusing each (returns original) with map (returns new array).
